bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 收复 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: Palantir rose 4.7% on Oct 21 to $201.72, trading between $189.88 and $202.55. It is above the falling 5-day ($195.0) and rising 10-day ($200.2), 30-day ($188.9), 100-day ($158.8) and 200-day ($153.0) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and is above zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($209.30), and RSI is 59.
read.zh: Palantir 10月21日上涨 4.7%，收于 $201.72，盘中区间 $189.88–202.55。股价位于下行的 5 日（$195.0）以及上行的 10 日（$200.2）、30 日（$188.9）、100 日（$158.8）和 200 日均线（$153.0）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$209.30），RSI 为 59。

read.en: The close cleared $195–200 (5 and 10-day averages, Oct 19 and 20 highs), which now becomes support. Resistance is $202.6–203.6 (day's high, Oct 16 high), then $209.3 (SAR) and $212.9 (Oct 12 52-week high). Support is $195–200, then $188.9–189.9 (30-day, Oct 20–21 lows) and $184.5. A close above $203.6 would open $209–213; a close below $188.9 would open $184.5.
